description.text: Teaching objectives The certificate courses are designed for non-degree seeking short-term and exchange students who will spend one or two semesters in China. The content of courses range from introductory to specialized, contemporary Chinese business concerns. Main courses Chinese Culture & Business Etiquette, Strategic Management in China, Markets & Marketing, Introduction to Money and Finance, The Changing Chinese Business Environment, Developing a Business in China. Chinese Economic Reform, M&A, Chinese Tax System and Business Law, Insight Chinese Trade and FDI, The Government and Politics in China, Chinese

duration.text: The Certificate in Chinese Business Studies at Beijing Foreign Studies University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4847 USD/per year ￥ 34900 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Academic transcript of high school 4.Custody release form 5.Certificate of completion of Secondary Education/O- level Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not, it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized. 6.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.

requirements.text: 1. Completed recognized upper secondary or equivalent Year 12 studies to the required standard 2. Satisfied English language requirements. Undergraduate applicants who provide TOEFL scores of at least 79 Internet-based (IBT) or an IELTS overall band score of at least 6.0 or TOEIC scores of 750 will be considered for regular admission. 3. Above 18 years old
